theorems.name: Submission.gaussGreenRep_extend_C1_functional
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (U : Set (Rn N)) (Λ₀ : (Rn N → Rn N) → ℝ), IsOpen U → (∀ (g : Rn N → Rn N) (W : Set (Rn N)), Continuous g → HasCompactSupport g → IsOpen W → tsupport g ⊆ W → ∃ K : Set (Rn N), IsCompact K ∧ tsupport g ⊆ K ∧ K ⊆ W ∧ ∃ h : ℕ → Rn N → Rn N, (∀ k, ContDiff ℝ 1 (h k) ∧ HasCompactSupport (h k) ∧ tsupport (h k) ⊆ K) ∧ TendstoUniformly h g atTop) → (∀ g h : Rn N → Rn N, ContDiff ℝ 1 g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ U → ContDiff ℝ 1 h → HasCompactSupport h → tsupport h ⊆ U → Λ₀ (g + h) = Λ₀ g + Λ₀ h) → (∀ (c : ℝ) (g : Rn N → Rn N), ContDiff ℝ 1 g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ U → Λ₀ (c • g) = c * Λ₀ g) → (∀ K : Set (Rn N), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ g : Rn N → Rn N, ContDiff ℝ 1 g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ K → ∀ M : ℝ, (∀ x, ‖g x‖ ≤ M) → |Λ₀ g| ≤ C * M) → ∃ Λ : (Rn N → Rn N) → ℝ, (∀ g h : Rn N → Rn N, Continuous g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ U → Continuous h → HasCompactSupport h → tsupport h ⊆ U → Λ (g + h) = Λ g + Λ h) ∧ (∀ (c : ℝ) (g : Rn N → Rn N), Continuous g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ U → Λ (c • g) = c * Λ g) ∧ (∀ K : Set (Rn N), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ g : Rn N → Rn N, Continuous g → tsupport g ⊆ K → (∀ x, ‖g x‖ ≤ 1) → Λ g ≤ C) ∧ ∀ g : Rn N → Rn N, ContDiff ℝ 1 g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ U → Λ g = Λ₀ g
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
